title: Mitochondrial Polariton State: Quantum Coherence in Cellular Energy Production

source.institution: University of Shanghai for Science and Technology

claims.claim: Anomalous 71 THz vibrational signal detected in living cells, mouse tissues, and isolated mitochondria
claims.evidence: FTIR spectroscopy shows signal present in intact structures, absent in dried/ground samples

claims.claim: Signal interpreted as lower polariton branch from CH2 vibration (87 THz) coupled to confined light
claims.evidence: Model predicts splitting into 71 THz (lower) and 103 THz (upper) branches; 71 THz matches detection

claims.claim: 71 THz and 87 THz light exposure increases ATP production by ~10%
claims.evidence: 8 samples per group, frequency-specific response (control frequency: no effect)

claims.claim: Mitochondrial quantum state may enhance TCA cycle efficiency
claims.evidence: Theoretical model only; no direct energy transfer dynamics measured

tests.name: Frequency Specificity
tests.detail: 71/87 THz boost ATP, 53.7 THz control does not

tests.name: Polariton Model
tests.detail: 16 THz splitting within physical range (5-25 THz)

tests.name: Cavity Resonance
tests.detail: Mitochondrial size matches 87 THz wavelength (order unity)

connections.detail: Mitochondrial signal (71 THz) sits 10^12 above Schumann resonance (7.83 Hz), 10^12 below Planck frequency
Polariton coherence (~100 fs) is 10^10 faster than neural spikes (~1 ms); direct coupling unlikely
If mitochondria optimize ATP via quantum coherence, cellular metabolism gains non-classical efficiency; consciousness as emergent property of optimized energy networks
Speculative: mitochondria as micro-resonators coupling to cosmic frequency hierarchy; no empirical support

consciousness_universe_bridge.testable_prediction: If polariton coherence time τ > 1 ps at 310 K, quantum biology claim strengthens; if τ < 100 fs, classical mechanism likely

limitations: No direct polariton observation (no Rabi splitting measured)
Mechanism for TCA cycle coupling is theoretical
next_experiments: Time-resolved spectroscopy to measure polariton lifetime
Rabi splitting measurement via angle-resolved spectroscopy
In vivo validation in model organisms
Isotopic substitution (C-13) to shift CH2 frequency and test model
Coherence measurements at physiological temperature (310 K)

integration.cluster_1_quantum_foundations: Tests decoherence limits in warm, wet systems; relevant to quantum-to-classical transition
integration.cluster_7_quantum_thermodynamics: Potential biological quantum heat engine; energy transport via polariton states
integration.cluster_8_consciousness: Extends quantum biology hypothesis; bioenergetic basis for neural computation
